findings.state: SEC-3 idempotency check + KDS/OSS API polls (all 10 scenarios)
findings.evidence_snippet: JSON `security.idempotency: {ok: false, first_status: 401, second_status: 401, replayed_header: null}`. All 10 scenarios `kds_poll.last_status: 401`, `oss_poll.last_status: 401`. Root cause: page.request.post()/get() carries browser session cookie but `/api/admin/pos`, `/api/admin/kds-order`, `/api/admin/oss-order` routes require Sanctum Bearer token (axios interceptor adds via localStorage) — page.request bypasses interceptor, so 401 fires before middleware.
findings.claim: Idempotency middleware was not exercised by this spec, and KDS/OSS API polling was not actually validated end-to-end via the API path. UI screenshots captured + DB independently verified, so business correctness is established by a different path (db_domain_events table + ui_db_total_match), but the API-level cross-check is a known scaffold gap. Already documented in wave-CAISSE-report.md `Anomalies surfaced #1 and #2`.
findings.fix_hint: Add helper `await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('token'))` to extract Bearer token in spec, pass as `Authorization: Bearer ${t}` to all page.request.* calls. Apply across rush-sync, audit-pos-cycle, and final-caisse specs.

findings.evidence_snippet: Tracking JSON `ui_receipt_total: null` for all 10 scenarios. Spec regex `MONTANT TOTAL\s+\d+,\d{2}` does not match. Actual receipt PNG shows totals as e.g. 'TOTAL: 15.20€' (lowercase 'TOTAL', colon, period decimal). The payment-modal MONTANT TOTAL with comma decimal is visible in CA-S10-05-payment-cash-keypad ('MONTANT TOTAL 15.20€'), but the post-pay receipt format differs.
findings.claim: ui_receipt_total assertion mechanism is non-functional — 10/10 returned null. UI = DB integrity is still verified via cart-total assertion (10/10 OK), so the load-bearing check passes. But the spec's claim 'receipt total matches' is unverifiable from this run's JSON; it is verifiable from the PNG via human inspection only.
findings.fix_hint: Update spec receipt-total regex to: `/(?:TOTAL|MONTANT TOTAL)[:\s]+(\d+[.,]\d{2})\s*€/i` to capture both payment-modal and printed-receipt formats with comma OR period decimal. Add unit test for the regex against captured DOM samples.
